Everything after that — shipping, title, disputes — is a legal process the code does not referee.

Tessella vaults physical artworks and sells fractional ownership of them on BNB Smart Chain. Governance registers an artwork with a custodian, an artist payout address and an appraisal; registration deploys a dedicated BEP-20 share token for that artwork and mints an ERC-721 provenance certificate to the custodian. The custody agreement and appraisal documents live at the artwork's

Tessella vaults physical artworks on BNB Smart Chain and sells them as one million ERC-20 fractions each. Every purchase pays a platform fee — and that fee is not pocketed. It is streamed back to the people who stake, block by block, from the contract that collected it.
